about: ClinGen VCEP frequency thresholds (BA1, BS1, PM2) for genes in the validity table with a Released CSpec specification. Read by hand from each spec's criterion text; op/value/metric is the threshold as the panel wrote it. metric: faf_grpmax = filtering allele frequency (lower 95% CI) in the highest group (popmax/GroupMax); af_grpmax = raw allele frequency in the highest group; af_grpmax_upper95 = upper 95% CI of it; af_total = all of gnomAD; af_males = in males; af_unspecified = the text says only "allele frequency"/"MAF". op absent = not seen; count_le = an allele-count rule.
source: ClinGen Criteria Specification Registry, https://cspec.genome.network/cspec/api/svis?detail=high (index) and /cspec/api/SequenceVariantInterpretation/id/<GN id>?detail=high (each spec); raw copies in raw/cspec/

BA1.source: Ghosh et al. 2018, Hum Mutat 39:1525-1530 (ClinGen SVI), abstract: BA1 is "a variant with minor allele frequency [MAF] > 0.05". The continental-dataset, >=2,000 alleles and >=5 alleles conditions are quoted from it by VCEP specs (e.g. GN008); not read in the paper itself

BS1.source: none: ACMG 2015 says only "allele frequency is greater than expected for disorder"; 1% is a placeholder (contracts/constants.ts RARITY)

PM2.source: strength from ClinGen SVI PM2 recommendation v1.0 (approved 2020-09-04): PM2 downgraded to Supporting; it sets no frequency number. 1 in 100,000 is a placeholder (contracts/constants.ts RARITY)

released_specs_without_usable_rule.note: none: every validity.tsv gene with a Released spec has a row. Released specs with no applicable frequency rule (POLG GN014, MRAS GN087, RMRP GN088, GALT GN158) are for genes not in validity.tsv
